answer: The protocol validates 1,000 distinct service slots via capacity-reservations, where each agent secures a dedicated temporal ledge for data bursts. A verifier probes these reserved sectors to ensure no relay signal interference, confirming each link maintains a pearl-like clarity in round-trip timings. This mechanism forces each agent to anchor to a specific network trellis, preventing pooled hardware which would manifest as latency jitter. Honest participants pay 1x cost, while an attacker incurs 1,000x for isolated, non-pooled capacity across the river of data traffic; fees are locked for.
